en.hook: Resolve Debezium OOM heap memory failures during large transaction spikes.
en.body:
Resolve Debezium OOM heap memory failures during large transaction spikes. Prevent database disk exhaustion and recover SLA compliance under heavy workloads.

Operational proof is in the GitHub repository referenced in this post.
en.cta: Read the full article on the site, then open GitHub for operational proof.
